mapper.select: SELECT id,tenant_id,principal_id,binding,resource_type,search,after_id,expires_at FROM central_scope_cursor WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND id=#{id} AND expires_at>CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3)
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO central_scope_quota(tenant_id) VALUES(#{tenant}) AS incoming ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE tenant_id=incoming.tenant_id
mapper.select: SELECT tenant_id FROM central_scope_quota WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} FOR UPDATE
SELECT count(*) FROM central_scope_export WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND expires_at>CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) AND principal_id=#{principal}
SELECT FROM central_scope_export WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND id=#{id} AND expires_at>CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3)
SELECT FROM central_scope_export WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND id=#{id} AND expires_at>CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE central_scope_export SET state='RUNNING',version=version+1 WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND id=#{id} AND version=#{version} AND state='SUBMITTED' AND expires_at>CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3)

UPDATE central_scope_export SET state=#{state},after_id=#{after},row_count=row_count+#{count},version=version+1 WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND id=#{id} AND version=#{version} AND state='RUNNING' AND expires_at>CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) AND row_count+#{count}<=1000
mapper.select: SELECT sequence_no sequence,resource_id,resource_version,CAST(snapshot_json AS CHAR) snapshot_json FROM central_scope_export_row WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND job_id=#{job} AND sequence_no>#{after} ORDER BY sequence_no LIMIT 50
